source.description:
We caught up with 𝗖𝗔 𝗦𝘂𝗷𝗮𝘁𝗵𝗮 𝗚, who was part of the committee involved in shaping KAOMA. 🎥

A Practicing Chartered Accountant specialising in Taxation, Real Estate & Technology Laws and an Independent Director, she brings first-hand insight into what this new law means for apartment owners, RWAs, and communities across Karnataka.

In this discussion, she breaks down the key aspects of KAOMA — your rights, your responsibilities, and what's changing under the new Act.

This is just a glimpse — the full video is dropping soon.

pack.topic: Apartment Association and Deed of Declaration Legal Verification in Coimbatore
pack.source_script_insight: The source video emphasizes the critical legal distinction between signing a simple deed of declaration and having actual registered association management rights under state apartment acts.
pack.coimbatore_angle: Applying proper legal verification of undivided share (UDS) and apartment association registration frameworks under Tamil Nadu housing rules for buyers in Coimbatore.
pack.core_takeaway: Never assume an apartment association is fully registered just by signing a deed; verify your building's legal title and association framework in Coimbatore.
